definitions.explanation: the profit before deducting operating expenses, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}の{粗利|あらり}は30%だ。
examples.english: The gross margin on this product is 30%.

examples.japanese: {粗利|あらり}を{上|あ}げるために{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}を{交渉|こうしょう}した。
examples.english: I negotiated the purchase price to increase the gross profit.

examples.japanese: {薄利多売|はくりたばい}の{戦略|せんりゃく}では、{粗利|あらり}は{低|ひく}くても{販売|はんばい}{数|すう}で{稼|かせ}ぐ。
examples.english: In a high-volume, low-margin strategy, you make money through sales volume even though gross profit is low.

notes:
{粗利|あらり} is a business/accounting term for gross profit, the profit before subtracting operating expenses.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {粗|そ/あら} (rough, coarse)
- {利|り} (profit, benefit)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
- Also written as {粗利|そり} or {粗利益|あらりえき}/{粗利益|そりえき}

CALCULATION:
- {粗利|あらり} = {売上|うりあげ} (sales) - {原価|げんか} (cost of goods)
- {粗利|あらり}{率|りつ} (gross margin rate/percentage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗利|あらり}が{高|たか}い (high gross margin)
- {粗利|あらり}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure gross profit)
- {粗利|あらり}{率|りつ}を{改善|かいぜん}する (to improve gross margin)

RELATED TERMS:
- {純利|じゅんり}/{純利益|じゅんりえき} (net profit)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{利益|りえき} (operating profit)
- {売上|うりあげ}{総|そう}{利益|りえき} (gross profit - formal term)
